notes.title: Where We Went, What We're Doing...
notes.content:
[h1]We've been out of touch these last few months. Here's why:
[/h1]

Hello again! It's been a while since you heard from us, It's been a crazy few months! We've been hard at work on[b][i] so many[/i][/b] new things in the game. Here is a short list of the awesome stuff we've been up to:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477054/05be0a522a932078c17932f6522bf98e8218d13c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] All kinds of brand new art: shaders, models, textures
[*] Completely new 'architecture' for the project code
[*] Improved gameplay cameras
[*] Chicken Customization system!!!!! :D 
[*] Some small Minigames
[*] New menu setup
[*] New mechanics in the works
[*] And finally.. the demo is on its way to launching soon!
[/list]

I'll expand on these in coming updates, but for now please enjoy this goofy glitchy chicken!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477054/24a20cde9ee689d53abff8aadeec479e475b2169.png[/img]

We'll be updating the Steam page soon, so if you haven't wishlisted Chicken Nuggets, now is a great time: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807020/Chicken_Nuggets/
